penalties_applied.name: b2c_at_scale_needed
penalties_applied.reason: Target is general consumers migrating off Google Photos — a B2C tool that needs thousands of downloads to generate meaningful revenue, with essentially zero willingness to pay for data export utilities.

rationale: Google Takeout frustration is real but low-frequency (people export their data maybe once or twice in their lives during a platform migration) and buyers are consumers who overwhelmingly expect this type of utility to be free. There are already free open-source tools (Porte, various scripts) that partially address this. The buyer has no budget line for a data export helper, and a solo operator cannot reach enough consumers cost-effectively to monetize it.
solution_plan: Not recommended for build. Even though the pain is genuine, it's a one-time consumer problem — people export from Google once and never pay for a utility that does it. The category is dominated by free open-source tools, and there is no business model that works for a solo operator here. You cannot sell a subscription for a one-time migration task to consumers who expect free tools. Drop.
notes: buyer_clarity fails build_gate (scored 3, floor is 6). willingness_to_pay fails build_gate (scored 3, floor is 5). operational_autonomy fails build_gate (scored 5, floor is 7). Total well below min_total_to_validate.
